# Super Admin — Route and Module Inventory

**Companion to `SUPER_ADMIN_COMPLETE_ARCHITECTURE_AUDIT.md`.** Evidence-based, generated by direct inspection of `frontend/src/App.jsx`, `frontend/src/components/BillingShell.jsx`, `frontend/src/service/*.js`, and `backend/app/modules/super_admin/router.py` on the current working tree (branch `nikhil`, on top of commit `23f54e3` plus uncommitted changes). All routes require `ProtectedRoute` (valid token + `role === "super_admin"`); finer-grained guards are noted per row where they exist.

| Metric Dictionary | 2647–2657 | `/metric-dictionary` | `metric_dictionary.read` |
| Global search | 2660–2671 | `/search` | `global_search.read` |

**Endpoint-count summary:** ~74 distinct route handlers in this one file. Roughly **34 gated by a specific `PlatformRole` capability**, roughly **40 gated only by the coarse `get_current_super_admin` floor** — see architecture audit §4/§8 for the specific list of sensitive endpoints in the latter group (password/MFA reset, all commercial mutations, org lifecycle transitions, Plane 1 kill switch).

## 5. Service-Call Fan-Out for Duplicated/Aliased Data

Two independent frontend surfaces poll and can mutate the same backend data with no shared caching or synchronization:
- `TriagePage.jsx` and `GovernancePage.jsx` both call into the Attention Engine (`getTriageSummary`, `listAttentionItems`, `acknowledge/assign/transition/suppressAttentionItem`) independently.
- `CommercialLens.jsx` (inside the dashboard) and `Plane1BillingPage.jsx` (its own route) both call `getSaasCommercialReporting()` and independently re-implement the same three-branch MRR currency-formatting logic.
- `FinancialOpsLens.jsx` (inside the dashboard) and `FinancialOperationsPage.jsx` (its own route, all 8 paths) both call `getFinancialOperationsSummary()` independently.

None of these are security issues — they are UX/architecture redundancy that increases the surface area for the two copies to drift (as already happened once: `CommercialLens.jsx`'s hardcoded fallback currency and `Plane1BillingPage.jsx`'s are copy-pasted, not shared).
